steps.title: Bond the spar into both wing panels
steps.goal: One straight wing: both panels bonded on the spar, roots square, no twist.

safety.text: Gloves on for epoxy. Mix no more than 15 g at a time.

actions.do: Scuff WNG-003 with 120 grit over the bonded length; wipe with isopropyl.
Mark the spar centre. Tape a stop `{ex_wing.root_y_m|mm} mm` each side of it: the panel roots.
Coat the bore of WNG-001 and the spar. Slide the panel on up to the left tape stop.
Repeat for WNG-002 on the right.
Lay the wing flat, tips weighted. Wipe off squeeze-out. Cure `12 h` at `>= 20 °C`.

check.text: Measure on the flat table after the cure.
check.target: span {ex_wing.tip_y_m*2|mm} ± 3 mm; root gap {ex_wing.root_y_m*2|mm} ± 1 mm; both tips touch the table

can_go_wrong.problem: Epoxy starts to set before the panel is fully on
can_go_wrong.fix: Bond one panel per batch; mix 15 g at most.

can_go_wrong.problem: Panel twists on the spar while curing
can_go_wrong.fix: Keep the tips weighted flat on the table until the cure is complete.

steps.title: Fit the servo and hinge the aileron
steps.goal: Aileron moves its full travel on a tape hinge, driven by a centred servo.

actions.do: Centre WNG-005 with the servo tester before it goes in.
Seat the servo in its pocket from below, lead toward the root. 2x M2x8 screws through the grommets, snug.
Hold WNG-004 at full up. Run tape along the top hinge line.
Fold the aileron fully down; put a second strip into the open gap (V hinge).
Fit horn and pushrod; with the servo centred, set the aileron to neutral.

check.text: Sweep the servo tester end to end; read the throw at the trailing edge.

can_go_wrong.problem: Aileron does not reach full throw
can_go_wrong.fix: Hinge tape too tight: re-tape with the surface held at full deflection.
Servo was not centred: remove the horn, centre, refit.

steps.title: Bolt the wing to the fuselage
steps.goal: Wing held by 2 bolts through the spar saddle: the one transport joint.

actions.do: Lower the wing, booms fitted, onto the fuselage. WNG-003 sits in the saddle.
Pass 2x M4x30 SHCS from above through saddle and spar; washer and nyloc inside the fuselage.
Tighten to `1.0 N m`, alternating. Stop if the tube creaks (crushing).

check.text: Look at the nuts, then move each tip up and down by 20 mm.
check.target: 2 full threads proud of each nyloc; no play at the saddle

can_go_wrong.problem: Bolt will not pass through the spar
can_go_wrong.fix: Holes not aligned: rotate the wing a little; never drill the bonded spar oversize.
Stop: back off a quarter turn. Report it; the joint needs a crush sleeve.
